title: Майбутнє в минулому
explanation:
**Майбутнє в минулому** — коли з погляду минулого щось ще мало статися: «я збирався», «він сказав, що прийде», «ми якраз мали виходити».

**was / were going to + V** — план або намір у минулому, який часто **не здійснився**: *I was going to call you, but I forgot.* Також прогноз, зроблений у минулому: *I knew it was going to rain.*

**would + V** — майбутнє з погляду минулого, особливо в непрямій мові й після *said, knew, thought, hoped*: *She said she **would** be late* (пряма мова: *I will be late*). *I never thought we **would** live in Poland.*

**was / were about to + V** — дія мала статися **ось-ось**: *We were about to leave when Vita's mum called.* **was / were supposed to + V** — так **мало бути** за планом, домовленістю чи правилом, але не вийшло: *The train was supposed to arrive at 8, but it was an hour late.*
formula: was/were **about to** + V — ось-ось · was/were **supposed to** + V — мало бути

head: Форма
Значення
Приклад
rows: We were going to fly, but we took the train.
He promised he would fix it.
I was about to go to bed when you texted.
You were supposed to buy bread!
They didn't know they were to meet again.

examples.en: I was going to cook dinner, but we ended up ordering sushi.
examples.uk: Я збирався приготувати вечерю, але врешті ми замовили суші.

examples.en: Vita said she would meet me at the station.
examples.uk: Віта сказала, що зустріне мене на вокзалі.

examples.en: I never imagined I would learn Polish.
examples.uk: Я ніколи не думав, що вивчу польську.

examples.en: We were just about to leave when it started pouring.
examples.uk: Ми якраз збиралися виходити, коли почалася злива.

examples.en: The plumber was supposed to come on Monday.
I knew this winter was going to be long.
examples.uk: Я знав, що ця зима буде довгою.

tip: *was going to* — **мій** намір; *was supposed to* — **зовнішній** план чи обов'язок. *I was going to clean* — я збирався прибрати; *I was supposed to clean* — від мене цього чекали (а я не зробив).

exercises.prompt: I ___ call you last night, but my phone died.
exercises.explanation: Намір у минулому, який не здійснився.

exercises.prompt: She promised she ___ help us, but she never came.
exercises.explanation: Майбутнє з погляду минулого після promised → would.

exercises.prompt: We were ___ to leave when the taxi driver called to say he was stuck in traffic.
The parcel ___ arrive on Tuesday, but it's Friday and it still isn't here.
exercises.explanation: Мало бути за планом: was supposed to.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (go) to Gdańsk last weekend, but Vita got sick. (намір, 4 слова)
answer: were going to go
exercises.explanation: Нездійснений план → were going to + V.

exercises.prompt: He said he ___ (be) home by ten. (2 слова)
answer: would be
'd be

exercises.prompt: I ___ (about / fall) asleep when the neighbours started drilling. (4 слова)
answer: was about to fall
exercises.explanation: Ось-ось мало статися → was about to.

exercises.prompt: You ___ (supposed / text) me when you landed! (4 слова)
answer: were supposed to text
exercises.explanation: Очікувалося, але не зроблено → were supposed to.

She told me she will be late, so I waited.

answer: I was just about to text you.
I was just about to write to you.
I was about to text you.

exercises.prompt: "I'll fix the tap tomorrow," he said.
exercises.instruction: Перепишіть у непряму мову, почніть з He said…
answer: He said he would fix the tap the next day.
He said that he would fix the tap the next day.
He said he would fix the tap the following day.
He said that he would fix the tap the following day.
He said he would fix the tap tomorrow.
He said that he would fix the tap tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: will → would, tomorrow → the next day.
